parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame is the outer casing of the display, made of ABS plastic, providing structural support and protection for internal components.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the screen and buttons in place, protecting internal electronics from damage and dust.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that provides rigidity and shape to the display.

parts.name: Screen
parts.Basic_description: The screen is a flat glass surface that displays visual information to the user.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main interface for viewing data, images, or video output from the device.
parts.Movement_description: It is a stationary part but may respond to touch if it is a touchscreen.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A circular rubber button located below the screen, used for user input.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to control functions such as power or menu navigation.
parts.Movement_description: It moves inward when pressed and returns to its original position when released.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A smaller rubber button positioned near the main control area.
parts.Functional_description: It may serve as a secondary control, such as adjusting brightness or volume.
parts.Movement_description: It depresses slightly when pressed and springs back after release.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: Another rubber button located on the front panel, similar in size to the others.
parts.Functional_description: It provides additional input functionality, possibly for navigation or selection.
parts.Movement_description: It moves inward when pressed and returns to its resting position afterward.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A fourth rubber button aligned with the others on the front interface.
parts.Functional_description: It may be used for specific control functions such as mode switching or confirmation.
parts.Movement_description: It is a pressable component that returns to its original position after being released.
